blocking_issues: Charity_Legal_Name is mapped unconditionally to entity.legal_name, but the source guide expressly says that where a charity's legal name is withheld, ACNC may substitute an alternate identifier in this field. The map therefore makes a legal-name claim for values that the source says may not be legal names. No discriminator, exclusion, or limitation addresses these records. This needs a safe treatment (for example, avoid making the legal-name claim where the value cannot be verified as a legal name, if the source provides a usable discriminator) before the mapping is acceptable for human review.
warnings: The attempted exploration failed with NameError because `records` was undefined. Thus the stated one-row-per-charity grain and no-duplicate-ABN assumption were not checked across the full discovery sample. Supplied examples show distinct ABNs, and source notes describe charity-level fields, so this is an evidential gap rather than a demonstrated grain error.

Other_Organisation_Names is appropriately left unmapped: source meaning mixes trading names and other names, without guaranteeing each value is a trading name. Operating_Countries is also conservatively left unmapped given observed AUS values and the ontology's explicitly overseas-location scope.

No entity status is inferred from being registered in an ACNC dataset; the source is a current weekly subset but does not provide an entity-status field. ACNC registration date is correctly kept distinct from entity/company registration, and establishment date is separately mapped.

The business address is documented as the charity's business address and Address_Type samples say Business; address components are appropriately address-scoped, not service-location claims. Reported operating regions and charity indicators are entity-scoped claims, not address locations.

The mapped subtype and beneficiary categories are supported by the guide's named categories and Y-indicator semantics; blanks are not emitted as negative claims. The zero responsible-person sentinel is excluded as documented.
The confidence scores are provisional judgments, as disclosed. High scores on directly documented fields are not themselves a blocker; the legal-name semantic exception is the material issue.
evidence_checked: ACNC user guide p. 2 §§6–11: ABN is the charity's ABN; Charity name is formally the legal/official name, except that an alternate identifier may be substituted when the legal name is withheld; other organisation names may be trading names or other names.

ACNC user guide p. 2 §§12–17: address is the charity business address; website where supplied; registration date is effective ACNC registration date, including the stated 3 December 2012 convention for some pre-ACNC registrations.
ACNC user guide p. 3 §§18–24: establishment date, latest-AIS size categories and blank meaning, zero responsible-person sentinel, and financial year-end semantics.
ACNC user guide pp. 4–6 §§25–34: state/territory operating indicators, ISO alpha-3 overseas-country description, subtype indicators, and beneficiary indicators.

Raw discovery rows 2–9: distinct sample ABNs; Address_Type is Business; examples of legal-name and other-name separation; dates, operating indicators, subtype/beneficiary Y values, and Operating_Countries values including AUS.

Previous mapping and validation feedback: legal name is mapped without conditions; status and company-type claims are not inferred; website value Instagram was quarantined; exploration script failed before checking duplicate ABNs.
